changelog: Mission-style yellow route blip to the depot after signing; purple admin teleport blips on agency and depots.
Removed the cooldown between job changes (sign / quit).
Fixed locales not loading at startup (texts showed raw keys).
Initial release: interim agency with free side jobs and per-job progression.
9 side jobs: firefighter, trucker, tow, metal detector, train & metro, farmer, garbage, car wash, gas station.
Duty system with depots, automatic outfits and level based pay bonus.
Full in-game configuration editor (/conf_acn_joblibre) with 3D raycast placement.
